findings.finding: New linked-SOC chain rule, returned point target, constrained linear feasibility, and restoration across calls match the targeted public-API checks.

Unrestricted-fit joint_normal is the original-coordinate undamped likelihood Gram. A fixed-current-SOC profile modifies logQ derivatives and therefore returns a constrained-chart Gram. Its objective is valid for the profile; its matrix cannot be interpreted as unrestricted covariance.

CLI uses fixed_current_soc metadata, whereas the initial assessment guard checked only has_current_soc. Assessment now detects both forms, preserves candidate points, and returns unresolved/full-support ranges for linked-chart matrices.

A generic scm_fit operational failure does not prove a profile target impossible. Failed profile solves must remain missing/unresolved; the unit H/u0 contradiction is independently known from its explicit inequalities.

remaining_limits: Finite profile grids and local nonlinear optimizers do not supply global confidence or coverage guarantees.
Projected/Kaufman Gauss-Newton curvature is an approximation to the optimized-residual Jacobian; the tested envelope objective gradient is the derivative used for descent.
Objective/step termination is distinct from projected-gradient stationarity; preserve termination_reason and final gradient.
The current unexcited_theta_mask tags absent positive/negative current signs; the likelihood null-space diagnostics retain additional unresolved directions.
Sampling and state ingestion at35Hz do not imply that an expensive estimation update runs on every sample.
Retained replay histories and explicit feature bases grow with data; no small fixed-memory implementation is certified.
